blocks: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:
Section 2022 of the Elections Code is amended to read:
If a person moves to another state with the intention of making it their domicile, the voter loses their domicile in this state.
digest: Existing law provides that a voter will lose their domicile in California if they move to another state with the intention of making it their domicile.
This bill would make nonsubstantive changes to this provision.
label: Introduced
subject: Elections: domicile.
title: An act to amend Section 2022 of the Elections Code, relating to elections.
